title: ProtoEEG: Structured Prototype Alignment for EEG Visual Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.33065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: EEG visual decoding remains difficult because scalp recordings are noisy, spatially coarse, and variable across trials and subjects. Most systems align each trial with a dense image embedding, although that embedding mixes semantic content with instance-specific texture, pose, and background. This target can demand details absent from EEG and provides no explicit account of the visual factors supporting a prediction. We propose \textbf{ProtoEEG}, a prototype-mediated framework that reformulates EEG--image alignment as soft composition over a shared learnable visual codebook. A trainable EEG encoder and a frozen visual teacher produce assignment distributions over the same $K=64$ prototypes. Their weighted reconstructions form a structured representation for retrieval and image generation. translated_title: ProtoEEG：用于脑电图视觉解码的结构化原型对齐
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）视觉解码仍然困难，因为头皮记录噪声大、空间分辨率粗糙，且在不同试验和被试之间存在差异。大多数系统将每次试验与稠密的图像嵌入对齐，然而这种嵌入将语义内容与实例特定的纹理、姿态和背景混杂在一起。这样的对齐目标可能要求EEG中根本不存在的细节，并且无法明确解释是哪些视觉因素支撑了预测结果。我们提出ProtoEEG，一个以原型为中介的框架，将EEG-图像对齐重新表述为在共享的可学习视觉码本上的软组合。一个可训练的EEG编码器和一个冻结的视觉教师模型在相同的K=64个原型上产生分配分布，它们的加权重构形成了用于检索和图像生成的结构化表示。原型对比提供主要的跨模态训练信号，分布对齐协调各模态对码本的使用，实例锚（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出ProtoEEG框架，将EEG-图像对齐重新表述为在共享的64个可学习视觉原型码本上的软组合，为EEG视觉解码、图像检索与生成提供了结构化且可解释的表示。
en_tdlr: ProtoEEG reformulates EEG-image alignment as soft composition over a shared learnable visual codebook of 64 prototypes, enabling structured and interpretable representations for EEG visual decoding, image retrieval, and generation.
